comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Google translated from this item's JP description:

Smokescreen ball
When used in the dungeon
Caused the smoke screen, enemy of alertness
I mitigate the rise.

Gran Atlas will be changing how dungeons work, so I expect we'll see this item appear then. I know you'll be able to bypass enemies in dungeons and move on to other floors; this probably plays a role in that.

comments.author: Donce
comments.body: these can be obtained in Fort San Domingo dungeon hidden passages
